newsitem.title: UK: T. Woodrow sees no rise in property profits.
newsitem.headline: T. Woodrow sees no rise in property profits.

text.p: British construction group Taylor Woodrow Plc said on Friday that it was not expecting an improvement in its property activity profits this year.

"While we have made a very encouraging start, it remains the case that much of the investment we are now making will offer returns in 1998 and beyond...," company chairman Colin Parsons told the annual meeting of shareholders.
The company's construction order book moved up to 782 million stg at the end of April from 758 million stg, Parsons said.
